scope: Installed API docstrings/metadata and frozen source code only. No index opened, native search, explain call, label lookup or new scorer implemented.

installed_api.scope_note: Confirmed current installed API, not retrospective proof that an unrecorded historical library binary was identical.

exactness_requirements: Explain the SAME fully composed final Query object, not V32 base query, raw numerical dot product or a new score engine. V115/V134/V142 layer multiple collector wrappers whose final query includes source/MAX/owner branches.

Current wrappers expose final candidate lists, not a separate serialized full query. A thin isolated interception of the final search call could capture the already-built Query without calling a collector, but it is not currently implemented or authorized for execution by this capacity audit.

Bind original query inputs, full ordered reference arrays, every raw source/confidence and score shard, exact heldout evaluation vector, quantization bounds, helper hashes, original index segments/schema/global statistics and installed runtime. For future serving experiments use the target-independent vector and recompute every delta instead.

Resolve existing technical DocAddress by a non-scoring document lookup. A SIRET reference may locate an existing document but must not be added as a positive/scoring feature or synthetic proof. No existing direct canonical-key-to-DocAddress mapping was established in the inspected adapter.

Check explanation total against already returned native totals and cut100 with the same floating-point/quantization semantics before interpreting an out-of100 target. This fidelity check has NOT been run.

Protected targets skipped before identity lookup; target outside original numerical universe explicitly recorded/skip under a numeric-diagnosis scope, never expanded or injected. National lexical-only availability is a separate existing branch, not repaired numerical coverage.
what_a_validated_postseal_explanation_co: Actual complete composite score and grouped contributions for an already indexed eligible target outside100, without rerunning an initial candidate collector or changing outputs.
Below actual cut100 versus boundary-score tie versus an inconsistent replay; possible branch-level score margin attribution on this already consumed diagnostic population.

It does NOT supply exact full national rank, tie multiplicity outside100, counterfactual retrieval gains, generalization or a new metric. Those require additional globally complete evidence, not a favorable tie assumption.

cost.known: One document explanation need not collect another top100. However building the exact layered query repeats the same full numeric and source bitplanes, model/source loading and global-index weight construction.
cost.unknown: No measured time/RSS or total526 replay cost; potentially query-build dominated for large reference universes. Not assumed fast or under1/2GiB merely because only one document is explained.
